record.one_liner: Sales CRM for small and medium-sized businesses covering leads, deals, contacts and pipeline management
record.auth_notes: API token obtained manually from the Pipedrive app (api_key); OAuth 2.0 authorization_code flow for apps installed by customers (oauth2).
record.access_notes: critic: access self_serve_trial -> self_serve_free. Pipedrive offers a free developer sandbox account (a regular Pipedrive company account for app developers, requested via a form on the developer site) that gives Developer Hub access for building integrations; the 14-day trial also exists. Sandbox is kept while the developer is building or publishing an app.
record.api_notes: RESTful v1 API with OpenAPI reference. Object-level coverage was not checked endpoint by endpoint.
record.blocker_notes: critic: verdict ready confirmed. Self-serve API token plus documented REST API; developer sandbox available. Marketplace listing of public OAuth apps may need review but is not required to build.
